article_title: Two German airport workers die of malaria after 'mosquito arrives on plane'

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A rare malaria outbreak among Frankfurt Airport workers that officials link to mosquitoes brought by plane
A new vaccine programme for every passenger using Frankfurt Airport
A decision to close Germany's airports because of tropical weather
A study showing that malaria now spreads directly between people in Frankfurt
tasks.correct_answer: A rare malaria outbreak among Frankfurt Airport workers that officials link to mosquitoes brought by plane
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בהתפרצות נדירה של מלריה בקרב עובדי נמל התעופה בפרנקפורט, שככל הנראה נגרמה מיתושים שהגיעו במטוס.

tasks.prompt: How many airport workers were infected, and how many had died when the article was published?
options: Four were infected and none died
Six were infected and two died
Two were infected and six died
Six were infected and all recovered
tasks.correct_answer: Six were infected and two died
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה שישה עובדים נדבקו, ובהודעת רשויות הבריאות נמסר ששניים מהם מתו.

tasks.prompt: What are officials doing with mosquitoes caught in traps at the airport?
options: Releasing them in another part of Germany
Using them to test a new passenger-screening system
Analysing them to determine their species and origin
Sending them to tropical countries without testing
tasks.correct_answer: Analysing them to determine their species and origin
tasks.explanation_hebrew: היתושים שנלכדים נבדקים במעבדה כדי לזהות את המין שלהם ואת מקורם.

tasks.prompt: Why can airport malaria be diagnosed late in Germany?
options: Malaria tests are forbidden at German airports
The infection always disappears before symptoms begin
Doctors expect malaria to spread directly between co-workers
A patient may have no travel history that would normally make doctors suspect malaria
tasks.correct_answer: A patient may have no travel history that would normally make doctors suspect malaria
tasks.explanation_hebrew: במקרה נדיר של הדבקה בנמל תעופה אין בהכרח היסטוריית נסיעה לאזור נגוע, ולכן החשד במלריה עלול לעלות באיחור.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “outbreak” mean?
options: A routine medical appointment
A sudden occurrence of several cases of a disease
A long-distance flight route
A laboratory instrument for catching insects
tasks.correct_answer: A sudden occurrence of several cases of a disease
tasks.explanation_hebrew: outbreak פירושו התפרצות — הופעה של כמה מקרי מחלה בזמן ובמקום מסוימים.

tasks.prompt: What does “transmitted” mean in the statement that malaria is transmitted by mosquitoes?
options: Prevented by a treatment
Discovered in a laboratory
Passed from one host to another
Reported by a spokesperson
tasks.correct_answer: Passed from one host to another
tasks.explanation_hebrew: transmitted פירושו מועבר; כאן הטפיל מועבר לבני אדם באמצעות עקיצת יתוש.

tasks.prompt: Give two reasons why Frankfurt officials consider the risk to the general public very low.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי סיבות מן הכתבה ולהסבירן בקצרה.
expected_points: Malaria does not spread from person to person
It is transmitted by certain mosquitoes
Transmission inside a German airport is rare
The infected workers had different jobs and worked in different airport areas
Officials installed mosquito traps and began an investigation

tasks.prompt: Explain why officials are analysing both blood samples and captured mosquitoes.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר מה כל סוג בדיקה עשוי לגלות וכיצד הוא מסייע בחקירת מקור ההתפרצות.
expected_points: Blood samples may show whether the six infections are linked
Officials want to know whether one mosquito or several mosquitoes caused the cases
Captured mosquitoes can be identified by species
Laboratory analysis may help determine where the mosquitoes came from
Together the evidence can test the theory that mosquitoes arrived by plane

tasks.prompt: Summarise the outbreak, the investigation and the public-health advice in 3–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את מספר הנדבקים והמתים, את ההסבר המשוער, צעד חקירה אחד והמלצה לציבור או לעובדים.
expected_points: Six male Frankfurt Airport workers contracted malaria
Two affected workers had died by the time of publication
Officials believe infected mosquitoes probably arrived on a plane
Mosquito traps and laboratory analysis are being used
Blood samples are being examined to establish links between cases
Employees with symptoms were encouraged to consult a doctor
Officials described the risk to the wider public as very low

tasks.prompt: Write a short notice for airport employees explaining what happened and what they should do if they develop symptoms.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח הודעה ברורה וזהירה באנגלית, בלי ליצור בהלה, ולהסתמך על לפחות שלושה פרטים מן הכתבה.
expected_points: State that a rare malaria outbreak affected airport workers
Mention that the suspected transmission was by mosquitoes, not between people
Say that traps and laboratory investigations are under way
Advise employees with symptoms to consult a doctor
Avoid claiming that the source has already been proved
Explain that officials consider the general-public risk very low
